name: Xao ga
summary: Xáo gà is the chicken bowl on the fixed kitchens at Đào Tấn.
origin: Đào Tấn serves a bowl the 28 April 2023 page calls xáo gà. The method in print is Thanh Chương’s, on the 13 February 2024 Người Lao Động page. Both stay.
taste: Người Lao Động says the Thanh Chương pot smells of lime leaf, hành tăm, turmeric, and chili, and that the meat of hill chicken is what that commune uses.
howToEat: On Đào Tấn, order what the stall calls xáo gà. The 28 April 2023 page does not say how it is cooked.

The Thanh Chương account uses hill chicken, coarse salt, and hành tăm. The blood is taken through a small cut so the neck skin stays whole, and the neck skin is stuffed with blood and boiled as dồi cổ. Bone and meat are separated. The meat is marinated at once with lime leaf, white salt, turmeric, and crushed fresh chili. The bones are chopped for a mộc. The finished pot is yellow and smells of lime leaf, hành tăm, turmeric, and chili. Người Lao Động says to pour it over rice. That article does not say the Đào Tấn bowl is this one.
where: Đường Đào Tấn, fixed kitchens, allowed 24 hours on the 27 April 2023 account. Thanh Chương is another commune. A 2026 night list was not opened. A price is Check on arrival.
